nights.title: tripleS
nights.name: TripleS
nights.extract: TripleS is a South Korean 24-member multinational girl group formed by Modhaus. They aim to be the world's first idol group, where the members will rotate between the full group, sub-units, and solo activities, as chosen by fans. Fans are able to participate and communicate with the group, such as deciding the sub-units and the content through NFT photo cards called "Objekts".

en.who: TripleS is a South Korean multinational girl group formed by Modhaus, with 24 members. It aims to be the world's first idol group, where fans help choose the activities.
facts: The group rotates its members between the full group, sub-units and solo activities.
Fans take part through NFT photo cards called Objekts.

de.who: TripleS ist eine südkoreanische, multinationale Mädchengruppe mit 24 Mitgliedern, die von Modhaus gegründet wurde. Die Gruppe will die erste Idol-Gruppe der Welt sein, in der Fans mitentscheiden.
facts: Die Mitglieder wechseln zwischen Gesamtgruppe, Subunits und Solo-Aktivitäten.
Fans beteiligen sich über NFT-Fotokarten namens Objekts.

tr.who: TripleS, Modhaus tarafından kurulmuş, 24 üyeli çok uluslu bir Güney Kore kız grubudur. Dünyanın ilk idol grubu olmayı hedefliyor; hayranlar faaliyetlerin belirlenmesine katılabiliyor.
facts: Üyeler tam grup, alt gruplar ve solo faaliyetler arasında dönüşümlü olarak yer alıyor.
Hayranlar NFT fotoğraf kartları olan Objekts aracılığıyla katılıyor.
